_comment: This file is the single source of truth for the ins_error_model.tflite runtime contract. Every field is derived from config.py and normalization_stats.npz generated by train.py. Do NOT edit manually — re-generate from train.py if retrained.
architecture: Conv1D-LSTM hybrid (Two-branch: IMU window + INS state)
training_dataset: IO-VNBD (Inertial Odometry Vehicle Navigation Benchmark Dataset, Synchronised V and S datasets)
training_framework: TensorFlow / Keras — exported to TFLite Float32 with unrolled LSTMs

units.acc_x: m/s² — linear acceleration X axis (gravity REMOVED — use event.acceleration not accelerationIncludingGravity)
units.gyro_yaw: rad/s — gyroscope rotation rate around Z (yaw) axis
units.gyro_pitch: rad/s — gyroscope rotation rate around X (pitch) axis
units.gyro_roll: rad/s — gyroscope rotation rate around Y (roll) axis

branch_1_imu_window.normalization: z-score: (x - imu_mean) / imu_std  applied per-feature across all 20 timesteps

normalization_stats._note: imu_std has 1e-8 added to prevent division by zero (from train.py). These values must match exactly — do NOT recompute from a subset of data.

branch_1_imu_window.nan_handling: Replace NaN/Inf with 0.0 before normalization. A zeroed sample is safer than NaN propagation through the LSTM.

units.ins_vel_x: m/s — INS-estimated velocity in East (ENU X) direction at the END of the current window
units.ins_vel_y: m/s — INS-estimated velocity in North (ENU Y) direction at the END of the current window

normalization_stats._note: state_std has 1e-8 added. Position features (ins_pos_x, ins_pos_y) are deliberately EXCLUDED — they are non-stationary and would make regression intractable.

units.err_vel_x: m/s — predicted INS velocity error in East (ENU X) direction
units.err_vel_y: m/s — predicted INS velocity error in North (ENU Y) direction

normalization_stats._note: y_std has 1e-8 added. Clip threshold during training was ±50 m/s (ERR_VEL_CLIP).

sign_convention.CRITICAL: This is the most important invariant. Getting this wrong silently inverts corrections.
sign_convention.operation: ADDITION (NOT subtraction). If the model predicts err_vel_x = +5 m/s, the INS underestimates by 5 m/s — add 5 to correct.

coordinate_frame.origin: Anchored to the GNSS fix at the start of each dead reckoning epoch
coordinate_frame.axis_mapping_note: The browser DeviceMotion API axes (X=right, Y=forward, Z=up in portrait) must be rotated into ENU using device orientation (alpha/beta/gamma) BEFORE feeding to this model. This rotation is performed in ins_mechanization.py on the Python side — the browser integration layer must replicate it.

operational_constraints.ready_condition: Model must not be invoked until rolling IMU buffer contains exactly 20 samples. Use a deque(maxlen=20) and check len==20.
operational_constraints.gnss_interaction: AI velocity correction feeds into the EKF as a measurement update. During GOOD GNSS (accuracy <= 10m, sats >= 6), AI may sleep (AI_SLEEP_ON_GOOD_GNSS=True) to save battery.

tflite_runtime.ops: TFLITE_BUILTINS only — no custom ops, no TF Select ops required
tflite_runtime.lstm_style: Unrolled LSTMs (for TFLite compatibility — unroll_lstms=True in export_tflite.py)
tflite_runtime.input_ordering_note: TFLite may order inputs alphabetically by tensor name. Always identify inputs by name ('imu_window', 'ins_state'), not by positional index.
tflite_runtime.browser_runtime: Use @tensorflow/tfjs or tflite-support WASM to load and run in-browser

provenance.normalization_generated_by: train.py::compute_normalization() — computed from training split only (never val/test)
provenance.dataset: IO-VNBD Synchronised Vehicle and Smartphone dataset (moved to ml-training/deadreckon-idr-dataset/IO-VNBD/)
provenance.session_split: Session-wise (not window-wise) to prevent data leakage. RANDOM_SEED=42, VAL_SPLIT=0.15, TEST_SPLIT=0.15.
